plan: My private value is $31. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid close to my true value. Since values are independent and randomly drawn, I want to maximize potential profit. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. My value is $31. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is to bid my true value. If I bid less, I risk losing the item even when winning would be profitable. If I bid more, I risk paying more than the item is worth to me. The worst case is paying close to my value, but bidding $31 ensures I only win if the prize is genuinely worth more than the second-highest bid. This maximizes my expected profit.
